observations: The page number «236» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 continues the parenthesis of p. 235 (JP2 0267, L39). After L27, a short double rule, centred, closes the additions and corrections; not transcribed as a line. The lower half of the page is blank; the text of the next page shows through, mirrored.

The cross-references, checked: Tab. 92 (p. 207, JP2 0239, N03) has the addition of C «S. . . (?) elmirech (?) a zodiaco in aequinoctialem radiatio cadit»; Tab. 7 (p. 118, JP2 0150, N13) has «Secundum Emirethium (?) cum fuerit ...»; Tab. 77a (p. 192, JP2 0224) has the head «Longitudo et Latitudo5)» over the columns of the parallax for the arguments 91 to 150, and Tab. 77 (p. 191, JP2 0223) gives the parallax in longitude in hours, minutes and seconds and the parallax in latitude in minutes and seconds of arc; p. 65 (JP2 0097) and p. 103 (JP2 0135, L09-L15) treat the length of the year.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.» (L01, L10, L12), «Nallino» (L01, L10, L12), «Eumathius» (L05, L08), «Ammonius» (L05), «Al-Zarḳālī» (L05), «Abū Isḥāḳ al-Naḳḳāsh» (L08), «Al-Zarḳālah» (L09), «Haskins» (L15), «Athelhards» (L16), «Kb.’s» (L17); «Ammonius» in L09 and «Aumer» (L07) are not spaced. Italics: «S... elmirech», «Secun-dum Emirethium», «Kānōn», «Dhu’l-Ḥidjdja», «al-mirrīkh», «al-mizādj», «Cor-pus Christi Coll.», «Auct. F. I. 9», «Longitudo et Latitudo». Bold: «5.», «6.», «7.». «77a» (L24, L25) with the a raised. The dash of «206—209» (L01) is printed in two pieces that touch, 49 px; the other dashes are long (45-48 px). A tick stands in the margin before «Eumathius» in L08 and a speck over the second s of «Mss.» in L19; not transcribed.
